definitions.gloss: loss of strength, going limp, relaxing muscles
definitions.explanation: The state of losing physical tension or strength, either intentionally (as in relaxation) or involuntarily (from shock, exhaustion, or disappointment).
A relaxed, understated quality, especially in comedy or creative works.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱力|だつりょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go limp, to lose strength)
- {脱力|だつりょく}{感|かん} (a feeling of limpness/relaxation)
- {脱力|だつりょく}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧ (deadpan style, low-key style)

USAGE:
Sense 1 is used both medically (loss of muscle strength) and casually (going limp from exhaustion, disappointment, or relief). Sense 2 ({脱力|だつりょく}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧) describes a deliberately understated, relaxed style in comedy, art, or fashion.
